title: Dai
capsule: The Kingdom of Dai was one of Xiang Yu's Eighteen Kingdoms, created in 206 BC when he split the former state of Zhao into Changshan and Dai and placed the deposed Zhao king, Zhao Xie, on Dai's throne as a consolation. Centered on the northern Zhao borderlands facing the steppe, Dai was territorially modest compared to the wealthier Changshan carved from the same partition. Zhao Xie's rule proved brief: he was restored as king of a reunified Zhao during the Chu–Han Contention before the Eighteen Kingdoms settlement collapsed entirely by 203 BC.
